svg.title: EXP-001 base paired revenue differences
svg.desc: Dot plot, one dot per stream, of revenue under each arm minus revenue under FIX on the same stream; the black bar is the mean; the dashed line is zero. OCC: n=4000, mean 407.04, min -1804.82, max 5403.78; DRP: n=4000, mean 462.08, min -3024.05, max 5381.06; FIX6: n=4000, mean -409.56, min -3928.72, max 1963.27
svg.text: EXP-001 base: paired revenue difference vs FIX (currency per season)
